facts.claim: The median app retains 4% of its users at day 30, and 25.3% return on day one
facts.source_title: Mobile App Retention Benchmarks by Industry 2026
facts.excerpt: The median app retains just 4% of users at Day 30. Only 25.3% of mobile app users return on Day 1.

facts.claim: iOS averages 25.65% day-one and 4.13% day-30 retention against 23.01% and 2.59% on Android
facts.source_title: Mobile App Retention Benchmarks by Industry 2026
facts.excerpt: iOS averages 25.65% on Day 1 and 4.13% on Day 30, while Android averages 23.01% on Day 1 and 2.59% on Day 30.

facts.claim: Monthly plans retain about 65% at day 30, 43% at day 90 and 17% at one year
facts.excerpt: For monthly plans, day 30 retention is approximately 65%, day 90 approximately 43%, and one-year approximately 17%.

facts.claim: Travel and Business lead annual renewal at a 40% median while Productivity and Photo & Video sit at 23%
facts.excerpt: Travel and Business apps see the highest median annual subscription renewal rate (40%); Productivity and Photo & Video see the lowest (23%).

facts.claim: Median first-month renewal runs 42% to 61% by category, with Business highest at 61% and Social & Lifestyle lowest at 42%
facts.excerpt: Median first renewal rate ranges from 42-61% between categories; Business achieves 61%, Social & Lifestyle 42%.

facts.claim: Average SaaS activation rate is 36%, with 20% to 40% counted as good and above 50% as excellent
facts.excerpt: Activation rate benchmarks show 36% average for SaaS in 2026. Good performance is 20% to 40% and excellent exceeds 50%.
